title: Size preservation under circuit restriction
statement: Let $m,n$ be natural numbers, let $p : \\mathrm{Fin}\,n \\to \\bbf_2$ be a Boolean assignment, and let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables. Restrict each literal whose variable index is less than $m$ to the corresponding variable among the first $m$ variables; replace each other literal by a constant gate with value given by that literal evaluated at $p$, and retain the circuit's gate structure. The resulting circuit has the same size as $C$.
